init.title: Polling interval
init.description: How often to check device connectivity and provide a playback fallback for older Supervisor releases. Playback changes are pushed when the Supervisor supports events.

user.title: Add a balenaSound device
user.description: Add a device by its balena device UUID and local Supervisor URL. Devices advertising balenaSound over mDNS are added automatically when Home Assistant shares their local network.

abort.not_balena_sound: This mDNS service does not identify a balenaSound device.

error.invalid_device: Enter a device UUID and a valid local HTTP(S) Supervisor URL.
